disk.guard: Before each transform/audit: reserve plus max(2GiB, twice observed job free-space consumption); capacity failure skips remaining jobs.
disk.limitation: Planning allowance is not an empirical output bound or a within-process write quota.

historical_raw_evidence: Shared original paths remain unavailable; new scratch identities do not rewrite historical records.
proof_and_attribution_review: Fresh per-arm Direct and whole-original alias audits; exact same-run graph-bound DSEC reuse only; valid timeout checkpoints retained; missing margins never zeroed.
rss: 100ms requested sampling plus observer work; complete observed PPid/start-token tree only; physical/shared-page and race limitations retained; no subtraction from transform budget.
witness_boundary: Absolute lanes/full saved domains/original model provenance; no requirement that discovery and final free-domain hashes agree.
